x-provenance.source: Derived from openapi/brown-bdr-api-openapi.yml and openapi/brown-bdr-iiif-openapi.yml, which were themselves derived from Brown's own API documentation wiki plus live probes on 2026-08-30. Brown publishes no JSON Schema. Not a Brown-authored artifact.

descriptive_datastreams.description: Descriptive metadata datastreams. `MODS` is the descriptive standard the BDR serves, as XML.

views.description: Viewer and IIIF endpoints, including `iiif_image_info` and `iiif_manifest`. These are the documented route from the item API into the IIIF surface; the IIIF paths are not otherwise discoverable, and `/iiif` is disallowed in the repository's robots.txt.
